text_block_list.name: Huge Crowd of People
text_block_list.text: Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
(It's the same dream again... There are so
many
smiling faces...)

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
A meet and greet for Umamusume fans is
going to
be held today, so I've come
along to help out as a
member of staff.
However...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: I finished moving the desks.

text_block_list.name: Meet and Greet Staff
text_block_list.text:
Thank you, and sorry for making you
help out
even though you're one of the
guests!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
It's no problem. If there's anything else I
can do,
just let me know.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Oguri. Is this where you were hidin'?
It's
almost time for the show to start, so
we'd better
get ready.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Sorry. I just wanted to see if there was
anything I
could help out with.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
What, didja have another dream where
you were
helpin' people out or
somethin'?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, sounds like she's had 'em a few
times
now—dreams where she's puttin'
smiles on tons of
people's faces 'n' stuff.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Come to think of it, I remember her
talking about
her dream where everyone
was happy that one
time I ran into her
during a mountain hike.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
I mean, she even volunteered herself as
a guest
for this meet and greet! Wantin'
to do whatever
ya can to make people
happy? Now that's real
classy!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I'm just thinking to myself about how
much effort
Oguri Cap is putting into
this meet and greet
when someone runs
up to us.

text_block_list.name: Event Sponsor
text_block_list.text:
Sorry to keep you waiting! Got a little
bogged
down making some last-minute
adjustments...

text_block_list.name: Event Sponsor
text_block_list.text:
There was some real buzz when word got
out that
you're all going to be speaking
today, so we've
had way more people
show up than we were
expecting.

text_block_list.name: Event Sponsor
text_block_list.text:
At this point, it's looking like our only
option's to
limit the number of
attendees...

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Aw, man! It'd be a real bummer if we had
to put a
lid on the party, but I guess we
can't go puttin'
the fans' safety at risk.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
These things happen. It's always a
gamble when
ya hold big events. We'll
just have to give 'em a
real heartfelt
apology about it.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
...I think I have an idea. What if we did
the event
twice?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Obviously, since this is my idea, I'm
willing to do
everything twice—the talk,
the performance, and
the actual meet
and greet with the fans, too.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
It's fine. I don't mind. Everyone looked
so happy
in that dream I had... I'd like to
see that in real
life too.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Since I started having that dream, I can't
help
remembering it whenever I see
someone smile.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
And I've realized that the dream's not
some
mysterious vision someone's
showing me.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Seeing everyone smile is what I want. I don't want to see people looking upset—I want to see them happy.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Ah, boy. If Oguri wants to see people
smiling so
bad that she's dreamin' about
it, I guess we got
no choice but to go
along with all this.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Sorry. I didn't even ask you two if you
were okay
with it.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Hey, c'mon, this is what friends are for!

Hey boss, the two of us are okay with
what Oguri
suggested.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Howzat sound? Feel like doin' this event
twice?

text_block_list.name: Event Sponsor
text_block_list.text:
B-but of course! Thank you very much!
I'll go
ahead and make the
arrangements!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And that's how the fan meet and greet
event ends
up being held twice...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
I think that was the last fan... I'm glad
things
worked out and everyone was
happy in the end.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Man, those smiles were contagious, huh?
I'm
feelin' pretty good myself after seein'
all of 'em!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
What're ya feelin' all self-satisfied for?
This is all
thanks to Oguri for wranglin'
us a happy endin'.
We owe her big time.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Tama, Inari... Thanks for going along
with
everything.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to Oguri Cap's conviction, both
fan meet
and greets are a spectacular
success.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
I think that was the last fan... I'm glad
things
worked out and everyone was...
happy...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Rrrumble...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Oh geez, Oguri's reached her limit!
Quick!
Someone go grab her a bite to
eat!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Having given both meet and greet
events her all,
Oguri Cap ends up
unsurprisingly exhausted.
